# Sub-Page: Staff FAQ - Willow Lake Day Camp
You can find this season’s dates and rates . There is no camp on July 4th. Staff must work all 39 days of camp and attend all orientation sessions which occur on a few June weeknights and weekends.

For campers, camp runs every day from 9 am – 4 pm. Staff members not riding camp vehicles arrive by 8:30 am and leave directly after the buses pull out at 4:00 pm. We are extremely organized and attentive to detail. Our program focuses on providing opportunities for campers to try new things, have fun and be active participants in all we have to offer. Group counselors stay with the same group of campers all day while specialists teach a particular activity.

If you are interested in working at Willow Lake please complete an online application. Once Willow Lake reviews your application, we may select you to come to camp for a face-to face interview. All applicants must also submit multiple references and are subject to a background check.

Our staff members serve as role models to our campers and are expected to maintain a neat and professional appearance. Each day of the summer, Willow Lake staff wear staff shirts which we provide. All staff (besides lifeguards) must wear sneakers and athletic or casual shorts each day as we are a very active camp. All group counselors are required to swim with their campers and must wear bathing suits while at the pool. Lifeguards and group counselors should also bring towels. No extremes in hair color, piercings or body art are permitted.

Our compensation is very competitive and varies by position. Staff are paid at the end of weeks 2, 4, 6 and 8. We provide our staff with the same quality lunch that our campers eat which includes a hot entrée, full salad bar and fresh fruit. All food we serve is prepared in a nut aware environment and is readied with no nut oils or products.

We interview thousands of applicants each year to find the right mix of people. We have high expectations for our staff and expect everybody to work as a team. Our goal is to provide each camper with a safe and happy summer. We know that you will find working here a fulfilling experience!

We are supportive of our staff and committed to your success at camp. We have an intensive orientation process before camp starts and we offer continued guidance and support throughout the summer.

**Dance Camp 2025**

![Image 2](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5afc452096e76f02176c79a8/a1a2e125-8a92-4919-ab23-e7e2395488b3/IMG_7072.jpg)

**Join Us This Summer!**

**Motion Arts Dance Camp is a hit every summer! Children will study the classic foundations of our program - modern, ballet, and jazz - in our welcoming studio atmosphere. We use both our indoor and outdoor spaces and have plenty of fun extras tailored to each age group.**

**Most of the camp day is spent participating in various technique classes. Campers will also devote time to crafts, games, and lunch/snack breaks outside in our private driveway.**

Performing Arts School
======================

![Image 58: Mpac Performing arts school](https://www.mayoarts.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/MPAC_SubBrands_RGB_PerformingArtsSchool_TransparentBG-1024x998.png)

MPAC’s Performing Arts School offers a wide variety of classes and programs for ages 3 – adult in Musical Theatre, Acting, Voice and much more!  Classes are offered for a 14 week Fall and Spring semester and throughout the summer.  This dynamic program serves over 1,000 students annually offering exceptional quality training in a nurturing and supportive atmosphere.  Find out more about what our world-class Performing Arts School has to offer…

### Summer 2025 Performing Arts School: Program Begins June 23rd!

Registration for our 2025 Summer Semester is NOW OPEN.

Please email [pas@mayoarts.org](mailto:pas@mayoarts.org "mailto:pas@mayoarts.org") with any Summer Semester related inquiries or call the Performing Arts School Hotline at (973) 539-0345 ext.6582.

[REGISTER NOW](https://www.mayoarts.org/education/performing-arts-school-registration/)

![Image 59: Performing Arts School students onstage](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)

Semester Offerings
------------------

We offer two 14 week semesters.  Our Fall semester runs from mid September through mid January.  The Spring semester runs mid January through mid May.  Classes are available for ages 3 – Adult in Musical Theatre, Acting, Voice,  Audition Technique,  Improvisation and more.  Registration opens in July for the Fall and November for the Spring.

Programs include:  Broadway Babies for 3 & 4 year olds, Broadway Kids ages 5&6, Broadway Kids 2 ages 7&8, Musical Theatre Workshop ages 9 – 12, Teen Musical Theatre Workshop, Broadway Kids Saturday, MTW Saturday ages 10-15, Teen MTW Saturday, Acting Workshop Junior, Teen Acting, Singing Kids, Song Performance Workshop, Teen Cabaret Workshop

Summer Programs
---------------

We offer 1 week, 2 week and 3 week programs in musical theatre and acting for ages 7 – 18!  Summer Registration opens annually in April.

![Image 61: MPAC students taking class onstage](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)

Master Classes and Enrichment Programs
--------------------------------------

Throughout the year we offer Master Classes with Broadway Artists and specialty enrichment programs.  These unique opportunities are for a variety of ages and include:  Magic classes, Mindfulness & Meditation, Open Mic Cabaret, Audition technique and more.

> _MPAC is definitely a place where you can be your best self._
> 
> _~ MPAC Performing Arts School student_

![Image 63: Performing Arts School students onstage](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)

Miracle Project
---------------

The Miracle Project New Jersey is an evidence-based, groundbreaking program which helps children and young adults with autism and other special needs build communication and social skills, community, and greater self-esteem though music, acting, dance, acting and storytelling. This creative dynamic socialization program was founded in 2004 in Los Angeles by Elaine Hall, and is now being implemented by MPAC – the only provider in the state of New Jersey.  Each semester, our Performing Arts School provides class offerings for our Miracle Project students or those interested in the program.

Private Instruction
-------------------

We are pleased to offer private coaching and voice instruction each semester with an expert staff of Instructors.  Perfect for preparing for an upcoming audition or performance, college audition or to sharpen your performance skills!

![Image 65: MPAC students singing onstage](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)

![Image 67: MPAC Performing Arts Company sings at The 2023 Starlight Ball](blob:http://localhost/e8a57f4972516a1d3218894eabc89576)

Auditions
---------

Our Performing Arts Company, now in its 15th year, is seeking talented, serious musical theatre performers ages 13-21 who can sing, dance, and act and are looking to use their talent to better the community! This musical troupe acts as ambassadors for the Mayo Performing Arts Center by performing Broadway-style musical numbers at community events, fundraisers, hospitals, special events, and festivals around New Jersey. Opportunities may also include high profile events including performing alongside celebrity performers on the MPAC stage. This is a great opportunity to sharpen  
your skills, gain exposure, and help those in need.

**Broadway STARZ WEEKLY SessionS**
==================================

Our popular Broadway camp is back! This is a class where students will work together to create and perform a show based on a new theme each week! At the end of the week, we ask our parents to join the last 15 minutes of camp to see what we have learned! Students will unleash their creativity where they will learn to collaborate on telling a story through movement and song. Join us each week for a new adventure! Classes run Monday through Friday from 9:30am - 12:30pm. Classes are for ages 3-6, drop-off only. All students must be potty trained. There is no class on Friday 7/4.

There is a $100 non-refundable deposit due upon registration. This deposit can be transferred to another camp if you need to change weeks.

**Program is $350 per weekly session, and a one-time 2025 Summer enrollment fee of $35.**
